answer: Staked curation gates each new identity: a curator locks 80 credits in a vault and issues one onyx seal binding the curator key to the identity key. Auditors verify the three tasks; if any is fake, the curator loses all 80 credits and every seal in that cluster freezes at the nadir audit. The kth fake needs a kth bond and a kth seal, so no seal is reused across clones. One thousand fakes lock 80,000 credits under joint slash; an honest agent needs one seal and one refundable bond. A rented-curator ring fails because curator accuracy hits the nadir floor, ending endorsement rights.
